name: probe_results_lookback
title: R2 probe with lookback kinds, merged corpus recapture (conf=clear)
description: 231 re-captured traces with lb_2..lb_64 positions (decile-matched controls). Core-kind AUROCs match prior merged results within noise. Lead time: LOO 0.97 at 2 tokens pre-onset, 0.86 at 4, 0.74 at 8, chance from 32.
caveats: Observational; lb negs are decile-matched controls; muse lookback n=9 per k.
